Class JobServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
com.qm.bupt.service.impl.JobServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
JobService
public class JobServiceImpl extends Object implements JobService
Implementation of JobService for job posting CRUD operations.

Handles the complete job lifecycle including ownership verification for update and delete operations. Auto-generates UUIDs and timestamps for new job postings.
